software: stdlib + pyarrow (parquet read only); cross-sectional statistical evaluation is independent stdlib code
label_caveat: ironflow liquidations are a capped-sample feed (not a complete census per RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 15); absence != zero; claims restricted to presence/intensity ordering

input_integrity.sha256_sidecars: assert .parquet.sha256 before every read; caches read-only

design.sign_convention: relative_improvement = (baseline - candidate) / baseline applied to Poisson deviance; positive = candidate better. Identical convention as BROAD-01.
design.feature_spec: B1 = RV-only (log rv24, log rv168); C2 = funding-conditioned (B1 + signed funding + abs funding pct + premium + OI + dislocation + MA deviation), z-scored train-only
design.regime_conditioning: RV-tercile + UTC-session bucket, expanding train-only thresholds
design.targets: per-coin per-hour next-hour observed liquidation intensity (count + notional), long/short separate
design.primary_arm: long arm (the SUPPORTED arm from BROAD-01: mean rank-IC 0.155133, CI95 [0.142081, 0.168895])
design.secondary_arm: short arm (null from BROAD-01: mean rank-IC -0.002054; reported descriptively only)

block_bootstrap.resampling_unit: complete UTC test block jointly across coins

stable_iff: sign_reproduced_fraction >= 0.80 on long arm (>= 24 of 30 blocks positive rank-IC)
first_half_vs_second_half mean rank-IC gap bootstrap CI95 excludes a sign reversal
ordered-block monotone trend test does not reject stationarity at frozen two-sided alpha_k
